input.quote: MSL agrees that MSL engineering will be priced to IBM on a "most favored customer" basis.
input.rationale: The only most-favoured-nation language in the Agreement runs in our favour: MSL undertakes that its engineering will be priced to IBM on a "most favored customer" basis (p1099), i.e. the Vendor grants the Customer best pricing. Searches for reciprocal formulations ("less favorable", "best price", third-party matching) and review of the pricing provisions (§ 7.0, § 8.2 Parts Cost Reductions) found no obligation requiring IBM to extend MSL terms no less favourable than those given to third parties or to match third-party offers; the tooling right of first refusal at p1104 is an IBM option, not an MFN burden. This meets the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer), so no redline is proposed.
